sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS Wireless Engineering Readiness Dashboard > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university. Aggregates portfolio evidence. Not Oulu affiliated.

methods: Methods are the badge file results/wireless_engineering_skill_badges.json and the open items in results/missing_evidence_todos.md. Badge values are partial. This dashboard does not score a university program.
